name: Bogie 9000
source:
A high school student, Juichi, and his classmate, Yayoi, are drawn into a shocking case: a female student on her way home is attacked in a deserted park, her clothes slashed with a knife. The case is connected to an incident that occurred 14 years ago... and the computer software "Bogie 9000" that predicts the events...

[Translated from TAKERU Press 1996-10/11]
translation:
高中生重一和他的同学弥生卷入了一起令人震惊的案件：一名女学生在回家的路上在一个废弃的公园里遭到袭击，她的衣服被刀划破。这起案件与14年前发生的一起事件有关……以及预测该事件的电脑软件“Bogie 9000”……

[译自TAKERU Press 1996-10/11]
